# Vendored files

- `shadcn-vue-tailwind.css`: copied on 2026-11-03 from `dist/tailwind.css` in the shadcn-vue npm package, version
  2.9.0, and not edited since. `src/style.css` imports it.
- `shadcn-vue-LICENSE`: that package's licence file, MIT, copied the same day.

Both are byte-identical to those files in the shadcn-vue 2.9.0 package (checked 2026-11-11).

Upstream: shadcn-vue, by unovue, https://github.com/unovue/shadcn-vue (MIT licence; retrieved 2026-11-11).
